description: Source code for managing page tables and memory mapping in Zephyr OS on Xtensa architecture, including functions for initialization, mapping, unmapping, and TLB shootdowns.

methods.name: is_pte_illegal
methods.description: Checks if a page table entry is illegal based on its attribute bits.

methods.name: init_page_table
methods.description: Initializes all entries in a page table to be illegal.

methods.name: alloc_l2_table
methods.description: Allocates a free level 2 page table from the pool.

methods.name: map_memory_range
methods.description: Maps a range of virtual addresses to physical addresses with specified attributes.

methods.name: map_memory
methods.description: Maps a memory range, with optional double mapping for cache coherency.

methods.name: xtensa_init_page_tables
methods.description: Initializes the kernel page tables and maps essential memory regions.

methods.name: __arch_mem_map
methods.description: Maps a virtual address to a physical address with specific cache and permission attributes.

methods.name: arch_mem_map
methods.description: Public API to map a memory region with specified size and flags.

methods.name: l2_page_table_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps a page from the level 2 page table, invalidating TLB entries if necessary.

methods.name: __arch_mem_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps a virtual address from the page tables, invalidating TLBs.

methods.name: arch_mem_unmap
methods.description: API to unmap a range of virtual memory.

methods.name: xtensa_mmu_tlb_shootdown
methods.description: Invalidates TLB entries across CPUs for page table updates.

methods.name: alloc_l1_table
methods.description: Allocates a level 1 page table for a new memory domain.

methods.name: dup_table
methods.description: Duplicates an existing page table for a new memory domain.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory domain with its own page tables and ASID.

methods.name: region_map_update
methods.description: Updates page table entries for a memory region with specific ring and attributes.

methods.name: update_region
methods.description: Updates a region of page tables, with optional double mapping and TLB shootdown.

methods.name: reset_region
methods.description: Resets a region of page tables to default permissions.

methods.name: xtensa_user_stack_perms
methods.description: Sets permissions for a thread's user stack.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_max_partitions_get
methods.description: Returns maximum number of memory domain partitions.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_partition_remove
methods.description: Removes a partition from a memory domain, resetting its region.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_partition_add
methods.description: Adds a partition to a memory domain with specified attributes.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_thread_add
methods.description: Adds a thread to a memory domain, updating page tables accordingly.

methods.name: arch_mem_domain_thread_remove
methods.description: Removes a thread from a memory domain, restoring stack permissions.

methods.name: page_validate
methods.description: Validates if a page is accessible with required permissions.

methods.name: arch_buffer_validate
methods.description: Validates if a buffer range is accessible with specified write permission.

methods.name: xtensa_swap_update_page_tables
methods.description: Updates page tables during thread swap, setting correct page mappings.
